key.name: toggle-active
key.summary: Suspend/resume all Virtual Monitors behavior (failsafe)

key.name: layout-single
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to single-region layout

key.name: layout-dual
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to dual-region layout

key.name: window-left
key.summary: Move focused window to previous region

key.name: window-right
key.summary: Move focused window to next region

key.name: layout-theater
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to theater layout (25/50/25)

key.name: layout-thirds
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to thirds layout

key.name: layout-mainside
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to main+side layout (70/30)

key.name: layout-dynamic
key.summary: Switch focused monitor to the dynamic layout (build splits with the select/split/close hotkeys)

key.name: swap-left
key.summary: Swap focused window with window in previous region

key.name: swap-right
key.summary: Swap focused window with window in next region

key.name: grow-region
key.summary: Grow focused window's region by 5% of monitor width

key.name: shrink-region
key.summary: Shrink focused window's region by 5% of monitor width

key.name: select-prev
key.summary: Select the previous region (dynamic layout only)

key.name: select-next
key.summary: Select the next region (dynamic layout only)

key.name: split-region
key.summary: Split the selected region into two halves (dynamic layout only)

key.name: close-region
key.summary: Close the selected region; its sibling takes over the space (dynamic layout only)

key.name: default-layout
key.summary: Layout for monitors that have not been switched yet

key.name: debug
key.summary: Verbose per-window event logging

key.name: fake-monitors
key.summary: Present layout regions as monitors so dash-to-panel renders one panel per region (experimental)

key.name: fake-min-region-fraction
key.summary: Only regions at least this wide (fraction of monitor width) get a panel via fake monitors; 0 = every region
